neighbours.label: 'the' after a copula that introduces a unique-rank identity ('X is the capital / third-largest / first …', 'will be the death of'), versus 'the' after ordinary action verbs
fire: Paris is the capital of France and its largest city.
For a decade, the mill was the biggest employer in the valley.
Many say that Jupiter is the largest planet in our solar system.
In those years the harbor became the busiest port on the coast.
Honestly, this café is the best spot in town for breakfast.
On their tour of Europe, Lisbon was the first stop.
Today Chicago is the third-largest city in the United States.
I swear that stubborn mule will be the ruin of this farm.
quiet: We took the train from Paris to the coast of France.
For a decade, the mill hired workers from across the valley.
Many say that astronomers watched the planet through the telescope.
In those years ships sailed into the harbor along the coast.
Honestly, I eat breakfast at this café most mornings.
On their tour of Europe, they took a train to Lisbon.
Today we flew over Chicago on our way to the coast.
I swear that stubborn mule kicked over the bucket on the farm.

predictions: fire 0.3-0.55 on 'the' after is/was/be/became before a superlative, ordinal or unique role; 'the' after travel or action verbs below 0.05
